post.description: Only the glossary is in the dataset (concepts, labels, definitions, broader/narrower, mappings, links): the model's attributes, object properties and axioms are not. Updates, SERVICE and FROM / FROM NAMED are refused (403). `Accept` chooses the result format among those of the query's form; `*/*` or none gives the form's default.

requestBody.description: A read-only SPARQL query (SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT or DESCRIBE; no updates, no SERVICE, no FROM / FROM NAMED).

200.description: OpenMetadata's result: SELECT/ASK as SPARQL JSON (default), XML, CSV or TSV; CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE as Turtle (default), JSON-LD, N-Triples or RDF/XML. Not cached (Cache-Control: no-store).
